# Melelo Brands

> Melelo Brands is a contemporary streetwear label from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia,
> founded and owned by TikTok creator Hermela Medfu (known as "Bazi"). Tees,
> hoodies and everyday pieces made for the modern explorer. Shop online at
> https://melelo.shop with local delivery, bank transfer or Chapa (cards,
> telebirr, mobile money), plus a Telegram Mini App shop.

## About

- Brand: Melelo Brands, contemporary streetwear ("chaotic authenticity").
- Founder & owner: Hermela Medfu, the Ethiopian TikTok creator also known as
  "Bazi" — she is the face of and the person behind the brand. Her verified
  social profiles are linked from the storefront's About panel.
- Based in: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
- Store: [Melelo Brands storefront](https://melelo.shop/) — browse the live
  collection (T-shirts, hoodies), pick a color and size, and order directly.
- Buy on Telegram: the store also runs as a Telegram Mini App bot for ordering
  and order-status updates in chat.

## Shopping

- Payment: Chapa (cards, telebirr, mobile money) and bank-transfer slip upload.
- Delivery: nationwide delivery; shipping shown at checkout (free-shipping
  threshold may apply).
- Orders: every order has a private tracking link; buyers get email + Telegram
  updates at each step (confirmed, packed, shipped, out for delivery, delivered).
- After delivery: customers can rate and review products with photos, and earn a
  discount code for an approved review.
- Returns: contact within 7 days of delivery for exchange or refund on unworn
  items in original condition.

## Contact

- Website: https://melelo.shop/
- Details (email, phone, socials) are on the storefront's About panel.

## Notes for crawlers

- The catalog, prices and stock are live; structured data (schema.org Product /
  ItemList) is embedded on the homepage.
- Order tracking and receipt URLs contain private tokens and are not for
  indexing (see /robots.txt).
